items.name: Ember shard
items.text: A sliver of red crystal, warm as a hand. A chip off the Ember Crown's heart-stone.

items.name: Letter sealed with a moth
items.text: To the miller: 'Keep it cold, keep it hidden, and the Court will keep its word.' Signed with a pressed grey moth.

items.name: Ring of King Aldric
items.text: A heavy gold ring with an ember-red stone. Warm when danger is near.

items.name: Grey Hunter's fang
items.text: A fang as long as your hand, threaded through with black briar.

items.name: Fletched arrow with blue feathers
items.text: Lyra's brother fletched his arrows with kingfisher feathers. This one was in the Hunter's den.

items.name: Sedge-knot charm
items.text: Knotted reeds and a fish bone. Mother Sedge says it keeps the drowning away.
